# Compute the set of liked song IDs
liked_song_ids = set(song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs)

# Compute the set of song IDs from song library
song_library_ids = set(song['song_id'] for song in song_library)

# Compute the set of song IDs from album library
album_library_song_ids = set()
for album in album_library:
    album_library_song_ids.update(album['song_ids'])

# Compute the set of song IDs from playlist library
playlist_library_song_ids = set()
for playlist in playlist_library:
    playlist_library_song_ids.update(playlist['song_ids'])

# Union of all library song IDs
all_library_song_ids = song_library_ids | album_library_song_ids | playlist_library_song_ids

# Liked songs that are in any of the libraries
liked_from_libraries = liked_song_ids & all_library_song_ids
print(f"Liked songs in libraries: {len(liked_from_libraries)}")
print(liked_from_libraries)
